title: Green object over Savannah River Site engineers

tellings.quote: Anderson and his colleagues were quickly overtaken by a green glowing object angular and size darting back and forth erratically at high speeds and altitudes with phenomenal maneuverability

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how on July 19, 1952, an engineer named John Anderson and his colleagues at the Savannah River Site, a US nuclear facility in South Carolina, were overtaken by a glowing green object. According to the account, it was angular, darted back and forth at high speed and altitude, and moved with phenomenal agility, the kind of story told to suggest such objects watch nuclear sites.
